eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Lane, OR; at 8:03 AM on AUG 14, 2023 Effective until 9:03 AM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is an emergency notice from the Lane County Sheriff's Office. The following areas are being issued a Level 3 (GO NOW) evacuation notice due to wildfire: Peninsula Road east of Timber Creek, and Big Fall Creek Road east of Peninsula Road. Level 3 means leave immediately! Do NOT take time to gather things. GO NOW! More information at www.lanecounty.org/bedrock
